_why: SYNTHETIC. Generated by running gapengine.py over an invented log, so the SHAPE is always exactly what the engine emits and cannot drift from it. The numbers carry no measurement and cannot be wrong.
_never: Do not replace these values with figures from a real log, ours or a reader's. Regenerate with `python3 fixtures/make_fixture.py` instead.

measured.dps_window_note: Engaged = damage over runs of hits with no gap above 15s, lasting 20s or more. Four shipped meters use four denominators; a DPS figure without its window is not a measurement. DAMAGE-SHIELD DAMAGE IS EXCLUDED. A player's own shield is never written in the first person -- the form is `<target> is pierced by <Owner>'s thorns`, naming the owner by character name, with zero `by You` variants across 139 logs -- so this engine cannot attribute it as a matter of the game's grammar, not as an oversight. A meter that counts damage shields will report a higher figure and both can be right.

resists.note: no landings of this spell appear as direct-damage lines (a damage-over-time effect reports differently), so the denominator is unknown and NO RATE IS CLAIMED

measured.stance_evidence: 48.5% even damage across 299 non-crit melee hits (killing blows excluded). Balanced prints ~50%, Offensive ~99%. Distance: 0.5 SE from Balanced, 17.6 SE from Offensive.

endpoint.convention: first hit to last hit, per engagement
endpoint.note: The final swing of each engagement is outside this denominator. `dps` is unchanged and this states what the other convention would give -- not which is correct.

window.note: Three populations in one block. A share is only a share against the population its numerator came from: sum(spells_landed[*].damage_total) divides by window.all_lines.damage, NOT by damage_dealt. Dividing it by damage_dealt on the log this engine was built against gives 202%.

deltas.falsifier: A following log at the same gear whose non-crit melee endpoint does not approximately double.

deltas.materiality: modest - a few percent of this character's output
deltas.falsifier: A following log at a measured bash rate above 0.43/s in melee showing no lane gain.

deltas.materiality: modest - a few percent of this character's output
deltas.falsifier: A following log at a measured kick rate above 0.43/s in melee showing no lane gain.

refusals.detail: Which obtainable item meets a stat floor is a catalogue question.
refusals.what_would_settle_it: eqlegendstools.com holds this and does it well. Link, do not clone.

refusals.detail: A log does not show worn stats. AC, resists and worn ATK were not seen.
refusals.what_would_settle_it: Worn stats from a source the reader trusts -- a gear planner's export, or a character-panel reading.

refusals.detail: Comparing how long two named characters were engaged is refused in all cases.

parse.note: Every line of a real EverQuest log carries a timestamp: measured 99.99%-100% across 4 logs and 189,460 lines. A share below 50% means the timestamp shape did not match, which is a fact about THIS PARSER AND THIS FILE and not about the character. `lines_in` COUNTS WHAT THE CALLER SUPPLIED, not what the file contained: text.split() on a file ending in a newline yields one more element than readlines() does. A one-line difference between two callers over one file is that, and is not an engine disagreement.

self_damage_excluded.note: A first-person line whose target is the reflexive pronoun is an HP-for-mana trade or self-inflicted damage, never output. Reported rather than dropped silently: 92,822 points on the corpus log.

verbs_unclassified.blocks_lane_rates_note: FALSE: lane rates, where null, are null for some other reason.
verbs_unclassified.note: Damage from these verbs IS in damage_dealt and dps. They contribute NOTHING to auto_attack_attempts, melee_seconds or any lane rate, because filing a verb without cadence evidence corrupts a denominator and that is worse than the gap it closes. An empty list means no such verb occurred, not that the check was skipped.

coverage.note: Every delta is a difference against this character's own observed baseline. No absolute modelled figure appears in this document, by design - HANDOFF.md 21.3.
